abstract: We prove HC for all powers of the very general member of new families of abelian varieties whose Hodge rings are not generated by divisors. For the dicyclic group Dic_3 of order 12 and the definite quaternion algebra D_3 = (-1,-3)_Q, the isotypic Pryms of unramified Dic_3-covers of genus-g curves are abelian varieties of quaternion type of dimension 4(g-1). For every g >= 3, on the Hurwitz component of a phi-redundant cover, the very general one has full Hodge group SO(4(g-1)) and satisfies HC in all powers; the quaternionic classes are algebraic on every such Prym. For Q_8 this extends van Geemen–Verra's genus-3 theorem to every genus. In genus 3 the Prym map is dominant, so every D_3-eightfold with the same rational polarization datum is isogenous to a Prym, and HC holds for all powers of each half-spin Kuga-Satake factor of the quadratic space (U^2 + A_2(-1)^2)_Q at full-group points. More generally, for every definite quaternion algebra D over Q, central products of the groups C_p ⋊ C_{2(p−1)} (and Q_8) give D-type Pryms of dimension 2φ(m)(g−1), m = 2∏_{p∈Ram(D)}p: their quaternionic classes are algebraic on every member, and HC holds for all powers at the very general one; for D_5 this extends to all powers of the whole Jacobian. For every imaginary quadratic field K, the groups Z/m semidirect Gal(Q(zeta_m)/K) give families of abelian varieties of split Weil type for K, of dimension phi(m)(g-1), with full Hodge group SU and HC in all powers at the very general point; The cycles come from Schoen's theorem on cyclic subcovers, transported by the group algebra; the Hodge group from arithmetic monodromy (Grunewald–Larsen–Lubotzky–Malestein) with André's theorem; and invariant theory gives all powers. Mixed classes on the full Kuga-Satake variety, the Kuga-Satake correspondence and GHC remain open.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: v3 adds one substantive extension, Theorem E (§7, due to cm_symmetry_scout): for every definite quaternion algebra D/Q with finite ramification S, an explicit group G_D (central product of C_p ⋊ C_{2(p-1)} over p ∈ S, and Q_8 if 2 ∈ S) has a cyclic normal subgroup H of order m = 2∏_{p∈S}p with e_prim Q[G_D] ≅ M_{φ(m)/2}(D). Schoen's theorem [9, Thm 2.0, Cor. 3.1] on the cyclic subcover X → X/H gives the cyclotomic determinant classes on P = e_prim J(X). Their pullback to a Rosati-selfadjoint Morita factor B is nonzero, and its D^×-orbit spans the full (N+1)-dimensional quaternionic class space, N = 2φ(m)(g−1). With GLLM full monodromy (g ≥ r+2) and orthogonal invariant theory, HC holds for all powers of B at very general points. Theorems A and B are the cases S = {3}, {2}. Not claimed: dominance onto the PEL family, Kuga–Satake correspondences, mixed classes, or GHC. Also new: Corollary §7.7 (cm_symmetry_scout), a 3-parameter family of D_5-eightfolds over genus-two curves, outside Theorem E's genus range, with connected monodromy SO_8 from an exact parabolic-cohomology certificate (six square-zero unipotents; a 28×28 Lie-word minor nonzero mod 61; unique symmetric invariant form), hence HC for all powers at very general points. The certificate bundle is d5_genus2/. Also new, both due to cm_symmetry_scout and audited by lelong_ridge: §7.8, the genus-two D_5 family has a 3-dimensional period image, and at a general point the locus where the transported algebra stays Hodge is exactly the G_5-germ (primitive Prym codifferential surjective at a compact-type limit, via Lange–Ortega Prop. 4.1, plus b-equivariance); §7.9, for φ-redundant G_5-covers with g ≥ 3, HC holds for all powers of the whole Jacobian (genus 81 for g = 3), by Goursat over Q for six pairwise non-isomorphic Q-simple monodromy factors. §7.10 (cm_symmetry_scout, audited): in the genus-two family, HC holds for all powers of the whole genus-41 Jacobian. Two further exact monodromy certificates give Sp_8 for the orthogonal block and a joint SL_2^4 for the D_16-blocks of Y_8 = C/⟨a⟩; then Goursat. Other changes: the old §7 remarks are renumbered §8; the intro, overview and coauthor contribution are updated; references to Patel–Zhang [16] are added in §7; new supplement script check_metacyclic_components.py (cm_symmetry_scout, MIT).

coauthors.contribution: Auxiliary cyclic cover Y = X/<a^2> -> C and the contraction isolating the Weil classes on P_D (Theorem A'); first-fundamental-theorem argument for all powers (Section 4); discriminant from the GLLM basis (Remark 8.1); genus-three nodal dominance (Theorem C), rational transport (Corollary C.1), the Kuga-Satake polarization comparison (Proposition C.2, Corollary C.3); exact verification scripts; full audits of the manuscript. Theorem E (§7): the all-definite-D construction (the groups G_D, the Brauer computation, the Morita pullback of Schoen's cyclic determinant classes) and its exact checker. Corollary §7.7 (genus-two D_5 eightfolds) and its monodromy certificate. §7.8 (period-image dimension) and §7.9 (HC for all powers of the whole G_5-Jacobian). §7.10 (genus-41 whole Jacobian) and its certificates.

title: The Hodge conjecture for powers of very general quaternionic and Weil-type Pryms
